retention.bodyRetention: fixture body retained subject to the configured capture policy

querySequence: request bounded body evidence for one known session
request bounded media or timeline analysis only when explicitly selected
verify the expected delivery bytes and query result

expectedContract.queryResult: one bounded synthetic result with no unavailable-body error
expectedContract.parity: all candidates must report the same delivery digest and bounded query result

collection.sampler: isolated app self-sampler at one-second cadence
collection.overhead: sampler performs one bounded process query and one datagram when a prior send is not pending; layout probes are separately labeled and excluded from timing comparison
collection.unavailableMetricPolicy: missing, unsupported, or failed measurements are encoded as unavailable and never as zero

stopConditions: existing memory or disk safety guard triggers
synthetic forwarding or expected-query contract fails
